words.en: A trainee is someone who is being taught how to do a particular job.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: Two countries signed a treaty to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家签署了一项条约以停止战争。
words.en: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more countries or groups, especially one that is written down and signed by their leaders.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.tr:
n. 琐事；少量
v. 玩弄；轻视
words.ex: He threw away a trifle of money on candy.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一点钱买糖果。
words.en: A trifle is something that is considered to have little importance, value, or significance. It can also refer to a small amount of something. As a verb, to trifle means to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: The team celebrated their triumph after winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 球队在赢得比赛后庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

words.ex: The troop marched into the town at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 部队在黎明时分进入城镇。
words.en: A troop is a group of soldiers or a large group of people or animals.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.tr: adj. 令人烦恼的；讨厌的；
words.ex: The noisy neighbors are troublesome.
words.ex_cn: 那些吵闹的邻居令人烦恼。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as troublesome, you mean that they cause you a lot of problems or worries.

words.ex: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹喇叭。
words.en: A trumpet is a brass musical instrument with a flared bell and three valves, producing a bright, penetrating tone.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with tuberculosis last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有结核病。
words.en: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: He typed the letter on an old typewriter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台旧打字机打了这封信。
words.en: A typewriter is a machine with keys that you press to print letters, numbers, or other characters onto paper.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探揭开了真相。
words.en: To uncover something means to remove the cover from it or to reveal it by investigation or inquiry.

words.ex: He had to undergo surgery last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周不得不接受手术。
words.en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you or is done to you.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: I clicked the button to undo my mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我点击了按钮来撤销我的错误。
words.en: To undo something means to reverse the effect of a previous action or to untie or unfasten something.

words.ex: He is undoubtedly the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.ex: It was unfortunate that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他没赶上公交车，真是不幸。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfortunate, you mean that something unpleasant or unlucky has happened to them. You can also describe the unpleasant things that happen to them as unfortunate.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: The two teams decide to unite for the competition.
words.ex_cn: 这两个队伍决定在比赛中联合起来。
words.en: If a group of people or things unite or if someone unites them, they join together and act as a group.

words.ex: The team showed unity in winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 团队在赢得比赛时展现了统一。
words.en: Unity refers to the state of being united or joined as a whole.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.tr:
adj. 竖直的；直立的；
adv. 笔直地；
words.ex: The picture is hanging upright on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画垂直地挂在墙上。
words.en: If you are sitting or standing upright, you are sitting or standing with your back straight, rather than bending or lying down.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.tr: adj. 最新的；最近的；新式的
words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up-to-date by reading news every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天读新闻来保持知识的更新。
words.en: Someone or something that is up-to-date has the most recent information or uses the newest methods or equipment.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.ex: The usage of this machine is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器的使用非常简单。
words.en: The way in which something is used or the fact of being used.

words.tr: v. 使用；利用；“use”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 习惯的；使用过的；二手的；
words.ex: He used a pen to write the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支笔写了这封信。
words.en: Previously owned by someone else; second-hand.

words.tr: n. 效用；实用；公用事业；
words.ex: The utility of this tool is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的效用非常高。
words.en: Utility refers to the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

words.ex: It was an utter mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个完全的错误。
words.en: To say something or to make a sound with your voice; complete or absolute.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.ex: He drives a red van to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的货车去上班。
words.en: A van is a road vehicle used for transporting goods or people, usually larger than a car but smaller than a truck.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.ex: The water vapor rose into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升上了天空。
words.en: Vapor is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapor can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.tr:
abbr. 影碟光盘；“Versatile Compact Disk”的缩写
abbr. 视频高密光盘；“Video Compact Disc”的缩写
words.ex: He bought a VCD of the movie last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一张这部电影的VCD。
words.en: A VCD (Video CD) is a home video format and the first format for distributing films on standard 120 mm optical discs. It was widely used in the 1990s and early 2000s.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: She wore a white veil on her wedding day.
words.ex_cn: 她在婚礼那天戴了一条白色的面纱。
words.en: A veil is a piece of thin soft cloth that women sometimes wear over their heads and which can also cover their face.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.ex: Please verify your email address.
words.ex_cn: 请核实你的电子邮件地址。
words.en: To verify something means to check or prove that it is true, accurate, or justified.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.ex: He is a veteran player with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位经验丰富的老练球员。
words.en: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience in a particular field or activity, especially in the armed forces.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.ex: The phone vibrates when it receives a call.
words.ex_cn: 当手机收到电话时，它会震动。
words.en: To vibrate means to move rapidly to and fro or up and down; to oscillate.

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: He used a videophone to talk to his grandma.
words.ex_cn: 他用视频电话和奶奶聊天。
words.en: A videophone is a telephone with a video screen, capable of transmitting both audio and video signals, allowing users to see each other while they converse.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: The viewer watched the movie on TV.
words.ex_cn: 观看者在电视上看了这部电影。
words.en: A viewer is someone who watches something, especially television.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: He put vinegar on his salad.
words.ex_cn: 他把醋倒在沙拉上。
words.en: A sour-tasting liquid used as a condiment or preservative, typically made by fermenting dilute alcoholic liquids such as wine, cider, or beer.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.ex: The violent storm destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场暴力的风暴摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If someone is violent, or if they do something that is violent, they use physical force or weapons to hurt, injure, or kill other people.

words.ex: She picked a violet from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵紫罗兰。
words.en: A violet is a small plant that has purple or white flowers in the spring.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr: n. 小提琴手；小提琴演奏者；
words.ex: The violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A violinist is a person who plays the violin.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
words.en: relating to seeing or to the eyes

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.ex: The battery has a voltage of 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池的电压是9伏特。
words.en: Voltage is the electrical force measured in volts that is needed to make a current flow in a circuit.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.tr: n. 四轮运货马车；敞篷货车；
words.ex: The farmer used a wooden wagon to carry crops.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用一辆木制四轮运货马车运送庄稼。
words.en: A wagon is a vehicle with four wheels, usually pulled by horses or oxen, used for transporting goods.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.ex: He wakes up at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点醒来。
words.en: To wake means to stop sleeping or to cause someone to stop sleeping. It can also refer to the trail left by a moving ship.

words.ex: The sun wakens the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳每天早晨唤醒鸟儿。
words.en: to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.tr:
n. 病房；病室；选区；
v. 监护；守护；挡住；
words.ex: The patient is in ward 5.
words.ex_cn: 病人在5号病房。
words.en: A ward is a separate room in a hospital, typically one allocated to a particular type of patient, or a person, especially a child, who is under the protection or care of a legal guardian or a court.

words.ex: The warmth of the sun made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的温暖让她露出了微笑。
words.en: The quality, state, or sensation of being warm; moderate and comfortable heat.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: He eats a watermelon every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都吃西瓜。
words.en: A watermelon is a large, round fruit with green skin, pink flesh, and black seeds.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.tr:
n. 波；波浪；海浪；
v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；
words.ex: The wave hit the shore softly.
words.ex_cn: 波浪轻轻拍打着海岸。
words.en: A wave is a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake. To wave means to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: He sold apples at the wayside.
words.ex_cn: 他在路边卖苹果。
words.en: The land adjacent to a road or path.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.ex: The storm weakened the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴削弱了那座旧桥。
words.en: To weaken something means to reduce its strength, intensity, or effectiveness.

words.ex: His weakness made him unable to fight back.
words.ex_cn: 他的软弱使他无法反击。
words.en: A weakness is a fault or lack of strength in someone's character or in a system, plan, or design.

words.ex: He built his wealth by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业积累了财富。
words.en: Wealth refers to an abundance of valuable possessions or money.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.tr:
v. 穿；戴；
n. 磨损；衣着；
words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: If you wear something such as clothes, shoes, or jewellery, you have them on your body or on part of your body.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.tr: n. 网络广播；网络直播
words.ex: He will webcast his speech tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将网络直播他的演讲。
words.en: A webcast is a transmission of audio or video content over the Internet using streaming media technology to distribute a single content source to many simultaneous listeners/viewers.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；落泪
v. 流泪；流出
words.ex: Her weep lasted for hours after the news.
words.ex_cn: 听到消息后，她的哭泣持续了数小时。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

words.tr:
v. 焊接
n. 焊接
words.ex: He welds metal pieces together with a torch.
words.ex_cn: 他用焊枪把金属片焊接在一起。
words.en: To join pieces of metal together by heating the surfaces until they melt and pressing them together.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.tr: adj. 众所周知的；著名的
words.ex: He is a well-known singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: A well-known person, place, or thing is one that is known about by a lot of people.

words.tr: n. 西方人；西欧人；（美国的）西部人
words.ex: The westerner tried dumplings for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这位西方人第一次尝试了饺子。
words.en: A person from the western part of a country or the Western world.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.tr:
n. 鞭子
v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动
words.ex: The farmer used a whip to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To whip means to hit a person or animal with a whip, or to move something quickly and suddenly.

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.tr: adj. 白领阶层的；脑力劳动的
words.ex: He works as a white-collar worker in an office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做白领工作。
words.en: Relating to the work done or the people who work in an office or other professional environment.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: He is wholly responsible for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他完全对这个错误负责。
words.en: Completely or entirely.

words.ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
words.ex_cn: 邪恶的女巫对王子施了咒语。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wicked, you mean that they are very bad, immoral, or cruel.

words.ex: They widened the road to fit more cars.
words.ex_cn: 他们加宽了这条路，以便容纳更多汽车。
words.en: To make or become wider.

words.tr: adj. 流传甚广的；分布广的；
words.ex: The flu became widespread last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感流传甚广。
words.en: Something that is widespread exists or happens over a large area, or to a great extent.

words.ex: The widow lives alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位寡妇独自住在一所小房子里。
words.en: A widow is a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.tr:
v. 赢；获得；
n. 胜利；赢得；
words.ex: I want to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我想赢这场比赛。
words.en: to achieve first position and/or get a prize in a competition, election, fight, etc.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: He uses a wireless mouse to work on his laptop.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个无线鼠标在笔记本电脑上工作。
words.en: Using radio, microwaves, etc. (as opposed to wires or cables) to transmit signals.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.tr:
v. 祝愿；希望；
n. 祝福；愿望；
words.ex: I wish you a happy birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我祝愿你生日快乐。
words.en: If you wish to do something or you wish to have it done for you, you want to do it or have it done.

words.ex: He is a man of great wit.
words.ex_cn: 他是个极具机智的人。
words.en: Wit is the ability to use words or ideas in a quick, clever, and amusing way.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.ex: She wore a woolen scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条羊毛围巾。
words.en: Made of wool; relating to wool.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: My workmate brought coffee to the office.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事给办公室带了咖啡。
words.en: A workmate is someone you work with.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.tr:
n. 崇拜；崇敬；礼拜；
v. 崇拜；尊崇；做礼拜；
words.ex: The ancient people showed worship to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 古人对太阳进行崇拜。
words.en: The feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity.

words.tr:
adj. 值得的；有…价值；
n. 价值；
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

words.ex: The old toy is worthless now.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧玩具现在毫无价值。
words.en: If something is worthless, it has no use or value.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.tr: adj. 值得…的；值得尊敬的；
words.ex: This book is worthy of reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something or someone is worthy of something, they deserve it because they have the qualities or abilities required.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.tr: n. 写作；文章； v. 写作；“write”的现在分词；
words.ex: His writing is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的写作清晰简洁。
words.en: The activity or skill of marking coherent words on paper and composing text.

words.ex: The doctor used an x-ray to check his bone.
words.ex_cn: 医生用X光检查了他的骨头。
words.en: An X-ray is a type of radiation that can pass through most solid materials. X-rays are used in medicine to make images of the inside of the body.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.tr:
v. 叫喊
n. 喊叫
words.ex: He yells when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会大喊。
words.en: If you yell, you shout loudly, usually because you are excited, angry, or in pain.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: I eat yogurt for breakfast every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早餐吃酸奶。
words.en: Yogurt is a slightly sour thick liquid made from milk with bacteria added to it, often eaten with fruit or used in cooking.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: The youngster rode his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻人每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A youngster is a young person, especially a child or teenager.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.ex: The cake is yummy.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕很好吃。
words.en: If you describe food as yummy, you mean that it tastes extremely good.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.tr:
v. 中止；中断；放弃；堕（胎）
n. 中止计划
words.ex: He decided to abort the mission because it was too dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 他决定中止任务，因为太危险了。
words.en: If an unborn baby is aborted, the pregnancy is ended deliberately and the baby is not born alive.

words.tr: adj. 荒唐的；荒唐可笑的；
words.ex: It's absurd to wear a coat in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天穿外套是荒唐的。
words.en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: He is an academician at the national academy.
words.ex_cn: 他是国家科学院的院士。
words.en: An academician is a member of an academy, especially of an academy of arts or sciences.

words.tr: n. 就职；即位；正式加入
words.ex: The king's accession was celebrated by the whole nation.
words.ex_cn: 国王的登基受到了全国的庆祝。
words.en: The act of attaining or gaining access to a position, right, or status.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: The manager showed accountability for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 经理对这个错误承担了责任。
words.en: The fact or condition of being accountable; responsibility.

words.tr: adj. 负有责任的；应作解释的
words.ex: He is accountable for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他要为自己的错误负责。
words.en: If you are accountable to someone for something that you do, you are responsible for it and must be prepared to justify your actions to that person.

words.tr: n. 会计工作；会计职业；
words.ex: He works in accountancy for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大公司从事会计工作。
words.en: Accountancy is the theory or practice of keeping and inspecting financial accounts.

words.tr: v. 解释说明；“account”的现在分词； n. 会计；会计学；
words.ex: He is accounting for his absence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解释他的缺席。
words.en: Accounting is the process of keeping financial accounts.

words.ex: He faced an accusation of stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他面临偷钱的指控。
words.en: An accusation is a statement saying that someone has done something wrong or illegal.

words.ex: He accustoms himself to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己习惯早起。
words.en: If you accustom yourself or someone else to something, you make yourself or them familiar with it or used to it.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.ex: The actuality is that he forgot his homework.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他忘了作业。
words.en: The state of existing in reality, as opposed to being potential, theoretical, or ideal.

words.ex: He is an addict who cannot stop smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他是个无法戒烟的瘾君子。
words.en: An addict is someone who is unable to stop taking harmful drugs, or someone who is very interested in something and spends a lot of time doing it.

words.tr: adj. 上瘾了的；入了迷的
words.ex: He is addicted to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: If you are addicted to something, you cannot stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to you.

words.ex: The game is addictive and hard to stop playing.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏令人上瘾，很难停止玩。
words.en: If a substance or activity is addictive, it makes you want more of it so that you become dependent on it.

words.ex: He adheres to his principles even when it's hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他仍然坚持自己的原则。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.ex: The adherence of the sticker to the wall is strong.
words.ex_cn: 贴纸对墙的粘附很强。
words.en: Adherence is the act of following or sticking to a particular set of beliefs, principles, or rules.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.ex: The two rooms adjoin each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个房间彼此相邻。
words.en: If one room, place, or object adjoins another, they are next to each other.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.ex: He was denied admittance to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他被拒绝进入音乐会。
words.en: Permission to enter a place.

words.tr: adv. 公认地；普遍承认地；诚然；
words.ex: Admittedly, he is not the best player, but he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 公认地，他不是最好的球员，但他很努力。
words.en: Used to express that you accept something is true or that you agree with it, even though you may not like it.

words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.ex: She adores her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜爱她的弟弟。
words.en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

words.ex: The advancement of technology helps people live better.
words.ex_cn: 技术的进步帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: The process of promoting a cause or plan; the act of moving forward or making progress.

words.ex: It is advantageous to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 早起是有利的。
words.en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

words.ex: The adventurer climbed the high mountain alone.
words.ex_cn: 这位冒险家独自爬上了高山。
words.en: An adventurer is someone who enjoys or seeks adventure, especially someone who travels to unknown or dangerous places.

words.tr: adj. 有冒险精神的；敢于创新的；
words.ex: He is an adventurous boy who loves climbing mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢爬山的有冒险精神的男孩。
words.en: Willing to take risks or to try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: The birds flew through the aerial sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在空中飞翔。
words.en: An aerial is a wire or rod that sends or receives radio or television signals. As an adjective, aerial describes things that are in the air or related to the air.

words.ex: He works in the aerospace industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在航空航天行业工作。
words.en: The branch of technology and industry concerned with both aviation and space flight.

words.tr:
adj. 审美的；美学的
n. 美学
words.ex: She loves the esthetic of old paintings.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢旧画的美感。
words.en: Relating to the appreciation of beauty or good taste, especially in the arts.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.ex: She loves the aesthetics of old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢老建筑的美感。
words.en: Aesthetics is a branch of philosophy dealing with the nature of beauty, art, and taste, and with the creation and appreciation of beauty.

words.ex: The local company is an affiliate of the big global brand.
words.ex_cn: 这家本地公司是这个全球大品牌的分公司。
words.en: If an organization is affiliated with another larger organization, it is officially connected with the larger organization or is a member of it.

words.ex: He affirm that the plan will work.
words.ex_cn: 他断言这个计划会成功。
words.en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: He affixed a stamp to the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮票贴在信封上。
words.en: To attach, fasten, or join something to something else.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.ex: Loud noise aggravates his headache.
words.ex_cn: 噪音加重了他的头痛。
words.en: If someone or something aggravates a situation, they make it worse.

words.tr:
n. 总计；集合体
adj. 合计的；总的
v. （使）聚集；聚合；总计为
words.ex: The aggregate of all sales this month is $50,000.
words.ex_cn: 本月所有销售额的总计是5万美元。
words.en: An aggregate is a number of things or people that are considered as a group or a whole.

words.tr: adj. 飞行的；空运的；空中传播的；
words.ex: The airborne soldiers jumped from the plane.
words.ex_cn: 这些空降士兵从飞机上跳下。
words.en: In the air; flying or transported by air.

words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.ex: He drank a glass of ale at the pub.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒吧喝了一杯麦芽酒。
words.en: Ale is a type of beer that is brewed using a warm fermentation method, resulting in a sweet, full-bodied and fruity taste.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.ex: He alleges that the manager stole money.
words.ex_cn: 他声称经理偷了钱。
words.en: If you allege that something bad is true, you say it but do not prove it.

words.ex: He allegedly stole the money.
words.ex_cn: 据他声称，他偷了钱。
words.en: Used to convey that something is claimed to be the case or have taken place, although there is no proof.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Each family was given an allotment of land to farm.
words.ex_cn: 每个家庭都被分配了一块土地来耕种。
words.en: An allotment is a share or portion of something that has been divided or distributed.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.ex: The bird flew aloft above the trees.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在树顶上方高飞。
words.en: If something is aloft, it is in the air or off the ground.

words.tr:
adj. 交替的；轮流的；间隔的；
v. （使）交替；（使）轮流；
words.ex: We take alternate days off work.
words.ex_cn: 我们隔天休息一次。
words.en: If something alternates between two things, it repeatedly changes from one to the other and back again.

words.ex: The sentence has ambiguity because it can mean two things.
words.ex_cn: 这句话有歧义，因为它可以有两种意思。
words.en: If you say that there is ambiguity in something, you mean that it is unclear or confusing, or it can be understood in more than one way.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: He amended the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送信件之前修正了它。
words.en: To amend something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

words.ex: The soldiers loaded ammunition into their guns.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们把弹药装进枪里。
words.en: Ammunition refers to the projectiles and propelling charges used in guns, firearms, or any other weapons.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: The speaker will amplify the sound for everyone to hear.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器会放大声音，让每个人都能听到。
words.en: To amplify something means to make it louder, stronger, or more detailed.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He uses analytic methods to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他使用解析方法来解决这个问题。
words.en: Analytic refers to the process of breaking down complex information or substances into smaller parts in order to understand or examine them.

words.tr: adj. 分析的；善于分析的；
words.ex: He uses analytical skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用分析能力解决数学问题。
words.en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

words.ex: He started his project anew after the failure.
words.ex_cn: 失败后，他重新开始了他的项目。
words.en: If you do something anew, you do it again, often in a different way from before.

words.tr:
adj. 有生命的；有活力的
v. 使具活力；做成动画
words.ex: The cartoon characters are animate and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 这些卡通角色是有生命的，充满活力。
words.en: To animate something means to give it life or to make it lively and energetic.

words.ex: The children love watching animated movies.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢看动画电影。
words.en: Animated means full of life or excitement, or made to appear to move as if by magic or technology.

words.ex: The loud noise was an annoyance to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 那阵噪音让每个人都感到烦恼。
words.en: Annoyance is the feeling of being slightly angry or impatient.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.tr: adj. 骇人的； v. “appall”的现在分词；
words.ex: The accident caused an appalling sight.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了一幅骇人的景象。
words.en: If you describe something as appalling, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or unpleasant, and that you find it extremely unacceptable.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He gave her a gift to appease her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他送她一份礼物来平息她的怒气。
words.en: If you try to appease someone, you try to stop them from being angry by giving them what they want.

words.ex: The appendix contains extra data for the report.
words.ex_cn: 附录包含了报告的额外数据。
words.en: An appendix is a section at the end of a book that contains additional information. It can also refer to the small tube attached to the large intestine in the human body, known as the vermiform appendix.

words.ex: The boss gave a positive appraisal of his work.
words.ex_cn: 老板对他的工作给予了积极的评估。
words.en: An appraisal is a judgement or assessment of the value, nature, or quality of something or someone.

words.ex: The teacher will appraise my essay next week.
words.ex_cn: 老师下周会评价我的作文。
words.en: If you appraise something or someone, you consider them carefully and form an opinion about them.

words.tr: n. 拨用；拨款；挪用；占有
words.ex: The government made an appropriation for education.
words.ex_cn: 政府为教育拨款。
words.en: The act of setting something aside for a specific purpose, especially funds.

words.ex: His answer was apt for the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答对这个问题很恰当。
words.en: If someone is apt to do something, they often do it and so it is likely that they will do it again.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: The knight wore heavy armor in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 骑士在战斗中穿着沉重的盔甲。
words.en: Armor is a protective covering that is used to prevent damage from being inflicted to an object, individual, or vehicle by direct contact weapons or projectiles, usually during combat.

words.ex: The knight wore heavy armour in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 骑士在战斗中穿着沉重的盔甲。
words.en: Armour is a protective covering that is used to prevent damage from being inflicted to an object, individual, or vehicle by direct contact weapons or projectiles, usually during combat.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: His arrogance made others dislike him.
words.ex_cn: 他的傲慢让其他人不喜欢他。
words.en: Arrogance is the quality of being arrogant, which means having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.

words.ex: He gave an arrogant answer to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他傲慢地回答了老师的问题。
words.en: Someone who is arrogant behaves in a proud, unpleasant way towards other people because they believe that they are more important than others.

words.ex: The artery carries blood from the heart.
words.ex_cn: 动脉将血液从心脏输送到身体。
words.en: An artery is a tube that carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He gave an artful answer to the tricky question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个棘手的问题给出了一个巧妙的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone as artful, you mean that they are clever and skillful at achieving what they want, especially by deceiving people.

words.ex: He can articulate his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的想法。
words.en: If you describe someone as articulate, you mean that they are able to express their thoughts and ideas easily and clearly.

words.tr: n. 人工制品；手工艺品；加工品
words.ex: The museum has an ancient artifact.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一件古代文物。
words.en: An artifact is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest.

words.ex: The army used artillery to attack the enemy base.
words.ex_cn: 军队用火炮攻击了敌方基地。
words.en: Artillery refers to large-caliber guns used in warfare on land.

words.ex: The balloon will ascend into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 气球将升上天空。
words.en: If you ascend a hill or staircase, you go up it. If a staircase or path ascends, it leads up to a higher place.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.ex: They ascribe his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

words.ex: The sailors swam ashore after the boat sank.
words.ex_cn: 船沉没后，水手们游到了岸上。
words.en: If someone or something comes ashore, they come from the sea onto the shore.

words.ex: The king was killed by an assassin.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一名刺客杀害了。
words.en: An assassin is a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons.

words.ex: The king was assassinated by a secret group.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一个秘密组织刺杀。
words.en: To assassinate someone means to murder them, especially for political reasons or for payment.

words.ex: The king's assassination shocked the whole country.
words.ex_cn: 国王的暗杀震惊了整个国家。
words.en: The act of killing someone important or famous, often for political reasons.

words.ex: The police investigated the assault on the old man.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了对那位老人的攻击。
words.en: An assault is a physical attack on someone, or a military attack on a place.

words.ex: She is assertive when she speaks up for her rights.
words.ex_cn: 当她为自己权利发声时，表现得坚定自信。
words.en: Someone who is assertive behaves confidently and is not frightened to say what they want or believe.

words.ex: He tries to assimilate new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力吸收新单词。
words.en: To assimilate means to take in and understand fully ideas, information, or culture, or to make something become part of a group or system.

words.ex: He gave me his assurance that the work would be done on time.
words.ex_cn: 他向我保证工作会按时完成。
words.en: If you give someone an assurance that something is true or will happen, you say that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, in order to make them feel less worried.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
words.en: Athletic is used to describe someone who is physically strong, fit, and good at sports, or something related to sports or physical activities.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: The accident is attributable to poor road conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故可归因于糟糕的路况。
words.en: Capable of being attributed to someone or something.

words.ex: The authenticity of the ancient painting was confirmed by experts.
words.ex_cn: 这幅古画的真实性得到了专家的确认。
words.en: The quality of being genuine or not corrupted from the original.

words.ex: The teacher gave an authoritative answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个权威性的回答。
words.en: If something is authoritative, it is respected and accepted as true or correct because it comes from a reliable source.

words.ex: The manager will authorize the payment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 经理明天将批准这笔付款。
words.en: To give official permission for something to happen, or to give someone official permission to do something.

words.ex: The factory uses automation to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用自动化来制造汽车。
words.en: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system of manufacturing or other production process.

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.ex: He did not avail himself of the opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他没有利用这个机会。
words.en: If you avail yourself of something, you use it or take advantage of it.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He turned his head to avert the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他转过头去避免了事故。
words.en: If you avert something unpleasant, you prevent it from happening.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: He showed avoidance of difficult math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他回避困难的数学问题。
words.en: The act of keeping away from or preventing something from happening.

words.tr: adj. 棒极了；令人敬畏的；令人畏惧的；
words.ex: The concert was awesome!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会棒极了！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as awesome, you are emphasizing that you think that they are very impressive or extraordinary.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.tr:
v. 使困惑；难倒；阻碍
n. 挡板；遮护物；阻碍体
words.ex: The magic trick baffled the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something baffles you, you cannot understand it or explain it.

words.tr: adj. 秃头的；不加修饰的；赤裸裸的
words.ex: The old man is bald.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是秃头的。
words.en: Someone who is bald has little or no hair on the top of their head.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.ex: He paid with a fifty-dollar banknote.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张五十美元的纸币付款。
words.en: A banknote is a piece of paper money, especially one issued by a central bank.

words.tr: n. 破产；倒闭；无偿付能力
words.ex: The company filed for bankruptcy last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年申请了破产。
words.en: Bankruptcy is a legal status of a person or other entity that cannot repay the debts it owes to creditors.

words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何庄稼。
words.en: If you describe something as barren, you mean that it is not able to produce anything, especially plants or crops.

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.ex: The battalion marched slowly through the town.
words.ex_cn: 那个营缓缓穿过小镇。
words.en: A battalion is a large group of soldiers that consists of three or more companies.

words.tr:
n. 击球员；
v. 连续猛击；
words.ex: The batter hit a home run in the ninth inning.
words.ex_cn: 击球员在第九局击出了全垒打。
words.en: To batter something means to hit it hard many times, often causing a lot of damage. In sports, a batter is the player who is trying to hit the ball in games like baseball or cricket. Batter can also refer to a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk or water, used to make pancakes or to coat food before frying.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.ex: His behavioral changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to the way in which someone behaves.

words.ex: His behavioural changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to or involving behaviour.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.ex: He is the beneficiary of his father's will.
words.ex_cn: 他是他父亲遗嘱的受益人。
words.en: A beneficiary is someone who receives money or other benefits as a result of something, especially a will or insurance policy.

words.tr: v. 使迷惑；使...不知所措
words.ex: The strange signs bewilder the children.
words.ex_cn: 这些奇怪的符号让孩子们感到迷惑。
words.en: If something bewilders you, it is so confusing or difficult that you cannot understand it.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: The ad is on a big billboard near the road.
words.ex_cn: 广告牌在路边的大广告牌上。
words.en: A billboard is a large outdoor board for displaying advertisements.

words.ex: He is a billionaire who owns many companies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位拥有许多公司的亿万富翁。
words.en: A billionaire is an extremely rich person who has money or property worth at least a billion dollars or pounds.

words.tr: n. 装订工；粘合剂；活页夹
words.ex: The binder stitched the pages together neatly.
words.ex_cn: 装订工把页面整齐地装订在一起。
words.en: A binder is a cover for holding loose sheets of paper, magazines, etc., together.

words.tr:
n. 宾果游戏
int. 太好了！
words.ex: He shouted bingo when he got five in a row.
words.ex_cn: 当他连成五子时，他大喊‘宾果’。
words.en: Bingo is a game in which each player has a card with numbers on it. The caller calls out numbers and if a player has that number on their card they mark it off. The first player to mark off all their numbers calls out 'Bingo!' and wins the game.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: He works in biomedical research at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院从事生物医学研究。
words.en: Relating to both biology and medicine, especially in the application of biological principles to medical research or practice.

words.ex: The bishop moves diagonally across the chessboard.
words.ex_cn: 象在国际象棋棋盘上斜着走。
